text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain finally rises on the Japanese 
Derby. Fuji Kiseki confidently handles the 
press scrum, sharing her enthusiasm with a 
touch of humor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spectators' expectations soared, and 
that junior Umamusume watched on with 
mixed emotions. Carrying everything on her 
shoulders, Fuji Kiseki headed to the race.
